2 هَرَّشَ بَيْنَ الكِلَابِ , (A, * K, * TK,) inf. n. تَهْرِيشٌ, (S, A, K,) He excited strife, or quarrel-ling, between, or among, the dogs; syn. حَرَّشَ: (S, * A, K, TK:) and بَيْنَ الكِلَابِ ↓ هارش , (A, Mgh, TA,) or بِالكِلَابِ, (S,) or بَعْضَ الكِلَابِ عَلَى بَعْضٍ, (K, * TK,) inf. n. مُهَارَشَةٌ (S, A, Mgh, K) and هِرَاشٌ, (S, Mgh,) he incited the dogs to attack one another. (S, Mgh, K.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] هرّش بَيْنَ القَوْمِ, (A,) or بَيْنَ النَّاسِ, (K,) inf. n. as above, (S, K,) (tropical:) He excited discord, dissension,
disorder, strife, quarrelling, or animosity, between, or among, the people. (S, * A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
